Your plate-pool lives at **https://joeuk89.github.io/plate-pool/** — your home kit is registered there as `kit=d33b57cc`.

Two kinds of link show up in your files:

- **Load a lift**: `https://joeuk89.github.io/plate-pool/?barbell=140.5lb&barbell.hardware=collar-clamp&kit=d33b57cc` (each routine page has one of these per lift)
- **Set up the home kit**: `https://joeuk89.github.io/plate-pool/#inventory=…` — a long encoded link that rebuilds your inventory on a fresh device. The full version is in `profile.md` and `pages/athlete.md`; it was too long to print here cleanly, so open one of those files if you need to copy it.
